headline: Menasting mining drops
title: Menasting | Desert Miner With Electric Drop Boost | Palworld Guide
video_script: Farming Electric Pals in Palworld one point zero? Menasting roams the Twilight Dunes at about level thirty one to forty three. Its partner skill, Steel Scorpion, adds five to ten percent defense and makes defeated Electric Pals drop forty to eighty percent more items. At base it works Mining level five and Lumbering level three. Will you recruit Menasting? Comment below!
description: Menasting in Palworld 1.0 lives in the Twilight Dunes, boosts Electric Pal drops and works Mining level five.
